content:
jessica: forwarding a customer escalation — invoice INV-7890 failed to settle. customer wanted to move to net-45 but the payment flow hit multiple errors. ticket: TCK-12487

jessica: customer notes — card declined twice, then we retried and got a billing API error: "402 Payment Required" + tax mismatch on VAT ID. they attached PO PDF but finance says PO not in system.

marta: assigning — this is Acme Analytics (enterprise). they switched to net-45 in the portal two days ago. i pushed the signed SOA last week. @lia can you confirm PO acceptance and whether net-45 was approved?

lia: looking. i can't find a PO on file for INV-7890. we have a provisional approval email but no PO number recorded. finance requires PO before marking net terms. can we get the PO scanned + vendor reference? customer says PO: ACME-PO-3344.

omar: from billing side, logs show the payment attempt sequence:
```
POST /v1/payments/charge INV-7890
-> 402 Payment Required {"code":"card_declined","decline_code":"insufficient_funds"}
Retry via saved card -> 502 from billing-webhook (timeout to tax-service)
Billing-service returned: {"error":"tax_mismatch","expected_country":"DE","provided_vat":"GB123"}
```

omar: looks like two separate problems: (1) card decline on initial charge, (2) tax calculation failed on retry due to VAT/country mismatch. the 502 caused the invoice to be left in limbo.

kevin: i pulled traces — billing-webhook had a spike of 502s between 10:22–10:26 UTC due to the tax-rate API failing auth (mid-rollout of new creds). the token rotation job had an edge-case where retries were disabled. i restarted the connector at 10:31 and errors dropped.

jessica: can we summarize steps to resolve for the customer? they want invoice cleared and net-45 honored. they also want to know why their PO wasn't picked up.

omar: action items from billing:
1) Manually clear the pending retry for INV-7890 once we confirm payment method.
2) Recompute tax with correct VAT ID and country mapping.
3) If recompute succeeds and payment clears, mark invoice as paid; otherwise offer provisional credit for net-45 until PO is validated.

lia: finance asks for PO scan + contract clause confirming net-45. once we have PO we can authorize net terms and release hold. if no PO, policy requires prepay for first invoice or an exec sign-off.

marta: i've asked the customer for the PO scan (ACME-PO-3344) and their accounting contact. they replied with PDF and VAT country updated to DE.

omar: re-run repro locally to confirm fix. steps:
1) set VAT="DE" and VAT_ID="DE99999999"
2) curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-7890/charge -d '{"payment_method":"pm_***"}'
3) expect 200 or 402 with decline_code. if 502 appears, check tax-service logs: kubectl -n billing logs tax-service | grep 502

kevin: note — the previous token rotation bug is patched in canary. patch release includes better retry semantics for tax-service calls. will promote to prod in 2h.

billing-bot: [automated] invoice INV-7890 status changed: pending -> retrying at 1935012540 (recompute tax queued).

jessica: customer updated: they re-added card with higher limit and resent PO PDF. asked for ETA on clearing. told them we'll aim to clear within 4 business hours after successful tax recompute and payment capture.

lia: once billing confirms capture, i'll lift the hold and mark net-45 as approved in the ledger. i'll also attach the PO to the invoice record.

marta: thanks team. i'll follow up with the customer after we see the capture. :thumbsup:

kevin: follow-up: monitor for any further 502s between 10:30–11:00 UTC. alerting rule adjusted to trigger at 3 errors in 5m.

jessica: closing loop — will update ticket TCK-12487 after capture. if payment still fails, we'll offer provisional credit pending PO verification.
